jobs.title: Rekrutmen New ODP (Officer Development Program) BSI 2026
jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) adalah bank di Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang perbankan syariah. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: New Officer Development Program (New ODP) ODP merupakan program percepatan career bagi talenta terbaik di Indonesia yang memiliki potensi dan motivasi tinggi untuk menjadi pemimpin masa depan di Industri Perbankan Syariah. Pada program ini, peserta akan mendapatkan pembelajaran menyeluruh mengenai industri perbankan, strategi bisnis, transformasi organisasi, inovasi produk, pengelolaan risiko, hingga optimalisasi proses bisnis. Peserta juga akan dibekali kemampuan analitis, problem solving, leadership, dan kolaborasi yang dibutuhkan untuk menghadapi tantangan organisasi yang terus berkembang. Requirements: Lulusan S1/S2 dari Universitas dalam/luar negeri IPK Minimal S1: 3,00 S2: 3,50 Memiliiki Sertifikasi TOFL ITP Min. 600 atau IELTS Min. 6,5 Memiliki prestasi akademik atau non akademik Memiliki Pengalaman sebagai

jobs.description: Socialhood Munich ist eine der spannendsten Friendship- & Social-Wellness-Communities in München. Wir schaffen einen echten Third Space für junge Menschen, die Lust haben, neue Leute kennenzulernen, echte Verbindungen aufzubauen und gemeinsam Social Experiences zu erleben. Über 1.000 Menschen waren bereits Teil unserer Experiences – und daraus sind hunderte neue Verbindungen entstanden. Jetzt wollen wir den nächsten Gang einlegen 🚀 Dafür suchen wir eine energiegeladene, kommunikative Person aus München, die unsere Social Events sichtbar macht, Menschen aktiviert und das Happening vor Ort zu einem tollen Erlebnis macht. Aufgaben DEINE MISSION Du vermarktest unsere Social Events über Social Media und Community-Kanäle und aktivierst Menschen zur Teilnahme. Du bist verantwortlich für die operative Umsetzung der Social Events vor Ort (Check-in, Ablauf, Atmosphäre, Community-Vibe, Content Creation). Du entwickelst und erstellst wertstiftende Content für Social Media in enger Abstimmung mit dem Team. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Teilnehmende, Partner:innen und Locations während der Events. Du sammelst Feedback und Insights direkt aus der Community und spielst diese ins Team zurück. Du arbeitest eng mit der Event Concept & Planning Lead Rolle zusammen. Qualifikation VORAUSSETZUNGEN Du wohnst in München und bist flexibel verfügbar, insbesondere abends und an Wochenenden. Du hast Erfahrung in Eventdurchführung und Community-Arbeit, sowie Content Creation & - Editing und Marketing. Du bist offen, kommunikativ und hast ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Gruppen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und hands-on. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und du kannst auch bilingual auf Deutsch/Englisch hosten Benefits ENTLOHNUNG & ZUSAMMENARBEIT Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt auf selbstständiger Basis (Freelance / Dienst- oder Werkvertrag) oder im Arbeitsverhältnis als Minijob, Teilzeit oder Werkstudent. Join CDDS and take ownership of our robotic End-of-Line test station, ensuring reliable and thorough validation of every drone. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. These checks span very different fields: propulsion, sensors, calibration, radio links, power and structure. You will work closely with our R&D and production teams, with the autonomy to shape the test architecture and the responsibility to prove it on the line. We are looking for rigour, curiosity and the persistence to follow a defect from its first symptom to a test that catches it every time. Design and maintain the test software framework: sequencing tests, driving instruments and robots, logging results and linking every measurement to a drone's serial number. jobs.description: inspire AG is the leading Swiss competence centre for product innovation and advanced manufacturing. The research group Intelligent Production Systems at inspire is based in Lugano, the southern part of Switzerland. This position sits at the interface between research and industry. Bufab Flos is gevestigd aan het Flight Forum in Eindhoven, midden in de innovatieve Brainport-regio. Vanuit hier werken we samen voor onze klanten in innovatieve sectoren zoals Automotive, Mechanical Engineering en Mechatronics. jobs.description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution. Role Overview Black Net is our internal digital platform and the operational backbone of the company, supporting everything from time tracking and absence requests to procurement and project reimbursements. As the platform and company grow, quality is essential. We are looking for an Automation Test Engineer to join the Black Net team as our first dedicated QA professional, working alongside two developers and a Product Owner to build, own, and continuously improve our testing framework and quality standards from the ground up. You will establish the right processes and tools, drive test automation, and ensure that we can accelerate development, including AI-assisted development, without compromising the reliability of existing functionality. jobs.title: Stage - Assistant(e) Communication & Développement Commercial (H/F)
jobs.description: Qui sommes nous ? Depuis plus de 22 ans, le groupe Dans le Noir ? fait découvrir une expérience sensorielle et humaine hors du commun à travers ses restaurants, spas et espaces sensoriels. Le concept repose sur une immersion dans l'obscurité totale, où les repères habituels disparaissent pour laisser place aux autres sens et favoriser une nouvelle façon de vivre les échanges et les expériences. Plébiscité par la presse et le grand public, le groupe est aujourd'hui présent dans 9 pays et 15 villes (Paris, Nantes, Bordeaux, Strasbourg, Toulouse, Marseille, Tours, Londres, Bruxelles, Lisbonne, Saint-Pétersbourg, Luxembourg, Genève, Mexico et Le Caire). Ses restaurants ont accueilli plus de 2,5 millions de visiteurs et font l'objet de près de 1 000 articles dans la presse internationale. Ouvert en octobre 2021, le restaurant de Toulouse est né d'un partenariat avec l'hôtel 4 étoiles Pullman Toulouse Centre Ramblas, aujourd'hui devenu le FirstName Toulouse, situé sur les allées Jean-Jaurès. Vos missions Sous la responsabilité du « Project Manager » et en collaboration quotidienne avec lui, vous participerez au bon fonctionnement et au développement de Dans le Noir ? Toulouse . Vous pourrez également être en contact direct avec la Directrice du développement international de Dans le Noir ? pour des missions ponctuelles. jobs.description: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer, Media Foundations - BeReal
jobs.description: About BeReal At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions. Role We are looking for a Senior iOS Camera & Video Engineer to join BeReal and work on one of the most critical parts of our product: the camera experience. You will build and improve the capture, image, and video pipelines behind BeReal's core flows, including multi-camera capture, instant capture, front/back video composition, and media quality. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working close to Apple's media APIs, solving real-time performance challenges, and delivering a fast, reliable, high-quality experience. What you will do: Design, build, and maintain high-performance camera and video features on iOS. Own and improve parts of our AVFoundation camera stack: capture sessions, devices, formats, frame rates, exposure, and device capabilities. Build and optimize real-time image and video processing pipelines. Improve capture quality, latency, stability, and smoothness across supported iPhone models. Work on multi-camera flows, front/back video composition, video encoding, media export, and audio/video synchronization. Optimize CPU, GPU, memory, battery usage, thermal behaviour, buffer allocation, and multithreaded processing. Investigate device-specific and iOS-version-specific behaviour, and propose pragmatic technical trade-offs. Work closely with iOS engineers, product, design, backend, and data teams. Contribute directly to the codebase and raise engineering standards around media performance and reliability. Profile 6+ years of iOS experience, including strong hands-on work on camera, video, or media-heavy features. Deep expertise with AVFoundation and iOS camera APIs: AVC

jobs.description: Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid) The Mission: Why We Exist Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores – giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time. A Day in the Life At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health. This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle, with a particular focus on developing patient stratification strategies, advancing disease understanding using ‘omic data, and identifying novel biomarkers. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders. For example, a Scientist may: Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information, through polygenic risk scores, with conventional risk factors, to find the individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from therapies. jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform)
jobs.description: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the role The Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform) will design, build and operate the data platform that makes UFORCE’s operational data usable for AI model training and validation. You will connect diverse data sources—from high-frequency telemetry and time series to imagery, video, documents and structured records—and make the resulting data discoverable, governed and reproducible. You will work hands-on across architecture, pipelines, data quality and platform operations, while helping other engineers and partner teams make sound technical decisions. This is a staff-level individual contributor role for someone who combines strong engineering judgment with a practical approach to delivery. You will partner with ML, product, engineering, field and security teams to build a platform that works for real use cases and operating constraints. Model research and model performance decisions remain with the accountable ML and product owners. What you’ll do Design and deliver a data platform for ingesting, storing, discovering and preparing heterogeneous data for approved analytics and ML workflows. Build reliable batch and streaming pipelines for priority data sources, with validation, schema evolution, retries, backfills, replay and appropriate handling of failed data. jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einem Graduate Teamlead für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in Salzgitter . Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen. Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort. Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”. Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Getting homes off fossil fuels means fitting millions of heat pumps, solar panels and batteries, and every one has to be designed, sold and fitted by an installer. The assets themselves already work brilliantly, but getting them into homes is still slow, complex and painful. Our mission is to change that: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run a renewables installation business, and get homes off fossil fuels way faster. In just a few years we've become the leading platform for heat pump installers in the UK and Ireland, with around half of all heat pump installations now being managed on Spruce. We've just launched our solar and battery product, and we're building on that to go after even bigger opportunities: every other type of job these installers do, the rest of how they run their business, and a bunch of new countries. We're now on the hunt for truly brilliant engineers to help us move faster and go further. 🌲 About Spruce Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. jobs.title: Machine Learning Researcher
jobs.description: About the Position Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it s like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You ll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we ve selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You ll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models. At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges—large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques. You ll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we re still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes. Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication. About you If you ve never thought about a career in finance, you re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here.

Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the Role: As a Forward Deployed Product Manager, AI Agent , you will create, deploy and optimize AI Agents that transform our customers’ businesses and delight their customers. This highly cross-functional and customer-facing role blends product thinking, a nose for value, and project leadership with senior customer executives. At the end of the day, you own each AI Agent and the outcomes they drive for our customers, and you take that personally. You are a creative, pragmatic problem solver who thrives in fast-paced environments, rolls up your sleeves to build, and excels at turning ambiguity into execution. In this role, you’ll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who will support the build, integrations and optimization to make the AI Agent product successful. You’ll also work closely with product and engineering, providing a tight feedback loop and custom tooling that will shape the future of our platform. What You’ll Do: Own AI Agent outcomes for our customer

jobs.title: KYB/AML Analyst, Sweden
jobs.description: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Ramp is launching payments across the EU through its Swedish payment institution. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards European businesses and keeps them trading, across Ramp's own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We're a small team that runs on frontier AI tooling: our operators build and use their own automations so they can spend their time on judgement, not admin. We're hiring a KYB/AML Analyst in Stockholm to review and onboard business customers of our Swedish entity, work directly with those customers to get them live, and resolve onboarding requirements raised by our partners. You'll join a small Swedish team and help keep onboarding moving every day as we grow. What You'll Do Carry out first-line (1LoD) KYB reviews of business customers onboarding with Ramp's Swedish payment institution: company verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, and risk assessment Decide standard cases end to end, and escalate complex or higher-risk cases with a clear rational

Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. jobs.title: Stage Développement C++ & Intelligence Artificielle générative
jobs.description: Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre logiciel Track Builder , outil d’aide à la génération de lignes ferroviaires destinées à la simulation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire de fin d’études pour concevoir un framework intelligent de migration et de compatibilité logicielle, développé en C++ et assisté par l’Intelligence Artificielle . Le Track Builder évolue régulièrement, entraînant des modifications de son architecture, de ses modèles de données, de ses couches SIG (QGIS), de ses formats de configuration (XML/XSD) et de ses composants logiciels. Ces évolutions nécessitent de garantir la compatibilité des projets existants avec les nouvelles versions de l'application, tout en préservant l'intégrité des données. L'objectif du stage est de concevoir un framework générique capable d'analyser les différences entre deux versions du logiciel, d'identifier les transformations nécessaires et d'automatiser la migration des projets existants. Les principales missions seront : Analyser l'architecture existante du Track Builder et identifier les éléments impactés par les évolutions de versions. Concevoir et développer un framework générique de migration en C++, basé sur une architecture modulaire, des interfaces génériques et des design patterns adaptés. Étudier et intégrer des mécanismes d'IA générative et de LLM pour analyser automatiquement les différences entre versions (code source, schémas XML/XSD, couches SIG, fichiers de configuration et templates). Développer un moteur de validation automatique permettant de contrôler l'intégrité et la cohérence des projets après migration. Étudier et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion des erreurs, de rollback et de sécurisation des migrations. Participer à l'intégration du framework dans le processus de développement et le pipeline CI/CD du Track Builder. Ce stage offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet à forte dimension technique, mêlant génie logiciel, architecture C++, Intelligence Artificielle générative et automat

jobs.description: Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. jobs.title: Stageopdracht Video Content Creator
jobs.description: Over Noldus Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Onze oplossingen worden gebruikt in uiteenlopende onderzoeksomgevingen, van universiteiten en laboratoria tot ziekenhuizen en bedrijven. We hebben onlangs onze website volledig vernieuwd. Een mooie stap vooruit, maar ons beeldmateriaal is nog niet overal meegegroeid. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen. De stageopdracht Hoe maken we onze innovatieve producten en software visueel aantrekkelijk, begrijpelijk en overtuigend voor onze websitebezoekers? Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwikkelen en produceren van nieuwe videocontent voor onze website en andere digitale kanalen. Samen met het E-commerce team bepaal je welke onderwerpen en producten we willen uitlichten en hoe we deze het beste kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: • Productvideo’s: laat zien hoe onze producten in de praktijk worden gebruikt en welke mogelijkheden ze bieden. • Softwaredemo’s en screen recordings: maak korte, duidelijke video’s waarin je functionaliteiten en toepassingen van onze software laat zien. • Customer stories: breng in beeld hoe onderzoekers onze oplossingen gebruiken en welke waarde ze toevoegen aan hun onderzoek. • Animaties en motion graphics: gebruik animatie om complexe technologie, processen of functionaliteiten eenvoudig uit te leggen. • Combinaties van bestaand en nieuw beeldmateriaal: ontwikkel creatieve manieren om bestaande content te vernieuwen en aan te vullen met nieuwe beelden. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot eindproduct. • Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerc

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Manager / Chef.fe de Projet Déploiement Technique
jobs.description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, deux choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, et pilotée par Loïc, elle fait le lien entre nos produits et les équipes hospitalières. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT In this role, you will tackle some of the most demanding high-voltage engineering challenges in the energy industry, developing electrical systems that enable next-generation plasma heating technologies. Your expertise will directly influence the performance, reliability, and safety of critical plant systems, shaping the electrical backbone of a first-of-a-kind fusion power plant. By advancing high-voltage power conversion, insulation, protection, and system integration, you will help transform cutting-edge scientific concepts into industrial-scale reality. jobs.title: Responsable Administratif et Financier F/H
jobs.description: Filiale du groupe familial indépendant SIFCOR (plus de 100 ans d'histoire), la société Forges de Courcelles conçoit et produit des pièces forgées et usinées de liaison, de moteur et de sécurité pour les plus grands constructeurs et équipementiers automobiles et poids lourds, mais aussi pour d’autres industries dans le cadre de sa stratégie de diversification. Avec un effectif de 430 collaborateurs et un chiffre d'affaires de 170 M€, dont 61 % réalisé à l'export, la société poursuit ses investissements industriels pour assurer son développement, être à la pointe de la technologie dans ses métiers et accompagner ses clients dans les transformations industrielles ; elle est par ailleurs engagée dans une politique RSE volontariste. Son ambition : être un acteur majeur du développement industriel responsable européen. Le groupe SIFCOR (200 M€ - 90000 tonnes de métal transformé) regroupe également Stévenin-Nollevaux, SIFCOR D&A et Decomatic, et a construit des partenariats industriels en Inde et en Chine. Rattaché(e) au Directeur Financier Groupe et en lien étroit avec le Responsable du Contrôle de Gestion Industriel, vous garantissez la fiabilité de l'information comptable et financière, la maîtrise des risques et la fluidité des processus. Votre périmètre est celui des Forges de Courcelles, avec des interventions ponctuelles dans d'autres sociétés du groupe. Vos missions principales : • Manager et fédérer l'équipe de 4 personnes : vous organisez, animez et coordonnez l’équipe dans un objectif d’efficience, assurez la montée en compétences pour répondre aux objectifs du service, accompagnez l’équipe dans les changements. • Garantir la fiabilité comptable et piloter les clôtures financières : vous supervisez la production comptable, sécurisez les clôtures mensuelles et annuelles dans le respect des délais Groupe, en lien avec le Contrôle de Gestion et les Commissaires aux comptes. • Superviser la trésorerie et sécuriser les flux financiers : vous veillez à l’optimisation

Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development. Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels. Nauwkeurig werkt
